API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APISCIM GroupsGets details of all SCIM groups for the specified Id P.
Gets details of all SCIM groups for the specified Id P.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/userconfig/v1/customers/:customerId/scimgroup/idpId/:idpId

Gets details of all SCIM groups for the specified Id P.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

idpId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the IdP.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

idpGroupId
string

The unique identifier of the SCIM Group.

scimUserId
int64

The unique identifier for the SCIM user.

scimUserName
string

Name of the SCIM user.

startTime
int64

The start of a time range for requesting last updated data (modified_time) for the SCIM group. This requires setting the endTime parameter as well.

endTime
int64

The end of a time range for requesting last updated data (modified_time) for the SCIM group. This requires setting the startTime parameter as well.

sortBy
string

Specifies the field name to sort the results. Supported Sort fields are (id,name,creationTime,modifiedTime).If not provided, results are sorted by modifiedTime

sortOrder
string

Sort the last updated time (modified_time) by ascending (ASC) or descending (DSC) order.

Default value: DSC
page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Default value: 1
Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Default value: 20
Example: 20
allEntries
boolean

Return all SCIM groups including the deleted ones if set to true

Default value: false
Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
500

OK

*/*
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
list
SCIMGroup[]
totalCount
int64
totalPages
int32
